description: Sixteen step switch and sequencer: a clock or an address voltage picks one of sixteen stages, each with its own output, gate and level

params.text: Sets how many stages the sequence runs through before starting again, 1 to 16
Scales its stage, 0 to 100% of the input signal or of 10V when nothing is patched into IN

inputs.text: Each rising edge moves on to the next stage
A high gate here runs the stages backwards while it lasts
A rising edge sends the sequence back to the first stage
Adds to the stage the clock has reached, 10/16V per step over 0-10V, wrapping around within the length
A high gate here holds the sequence where it is, ignoring the clock
The signal passed to the stage outputs; with nothing patched here every stage puts out 10V scaled by its own knob

outputs.text: Carries the input signal scaled by the active stage's knob, following the sequence from one stage to the next
A 0.05ms trigger whenever the sequence arrives at another stage
Carries the input signal scaled by its stage's knob while that stage is active, and 0V otherwise unless the menu is set to All
Carries 10V while its stage is active and 0V otherwise
The stage the sequence has reached as a voltage, 10/16V per step

menu: In mode — Track lets a stage follow the input while that stage is active; Sample takes the input once as the stage becomes active and holds it
Out mode — Solo puts 0V out of every stage that is not active; All leaves each stage holding the value it last took

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.4: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
